WITH driver_age_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    v.control_number,
    v.sequence_number,
    CASE 
      WHEN FLOOR(DATEDIFF(v.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) < 25 THEN 'under_25'
      ELSE 'over_25'
    END AS age_group,
    YEAR(v.gdate_happened) AS violation_year
  FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation v
  JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON CAST(v.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id
  WHERE v.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
    AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(v.gdate_happened) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
),

annual_violations_by_age AS (
  SELECT 
    age_group,
    violation_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_violations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT control_number) AS total_violation_events
  FROM driver_age_groups
  GROUP BY age_group, violation_year
),

avg_annual_violations AS (
  SELECT 
    age_group,
    AVG(total_violations) AS avg_violations_per_year
  FROM annual_violations_by_age
  GROUP BY age_group
)

SELECT 
  under_25.avg_violations_per_year AS under_25_avg,
  over_25.avg_violations_per_year AS over_25_avg,
  ((under_25.avg_violations_per_year - over_25.avg_violations_per_year) / over_25.avg_violations_per_year) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM 
  (SELECT avg_violations_per_year FROM avg_annual_violations WHERE age_group = 'under_25') under_25
CROSS JOIN 
  (SELECT avg_violations_per_year FROM avg_annual_violations WHERE age_group = 'over_25') over_25 LIMIT 20000
